question: When 0.03586 is rounded to the nearest 0.001, how many significant figures does the result have? (Enter only the number of significant figures.)
solution: Rounding 0.03586 to the nearest 0.001 gives 0.036. From the first nonzero digit on the left, 3, through the last digit, the digits are 3 and 6, giving a total of 2 significant figures.
